page.overview:
Who is Abadaner?

Abadaner was a member of the Five Worlds in 40 ABY working as insurgents on Coruscant during the Second Galactic Civil War.

He along with other Corellians were working with the bounty hunter Ailyn Habuur, though they were arrested after Ben Skywalker had a hunch about explosives in the area where they were located.
